_doc: Declared coverage targets for eval/quality_set.json, enforced by scripts/audit_eval_coverage.py. This is the design the set is governed to; edit the targets here (not the audit code) when the intended shape changes. See docs/eval_strategy.md and the eval-set-coverage-governance memory.
_route_floor_doc: Every capability route in use needs >=2 questions: one is a coin-flip to distinguish a route regression from an odd single case.
_reg_floors_doc: Counted by membership (a cross-reg question counts toward each reg it touches). Core regulations carry a >=2 floor; CIR has a single implementing reg in the corpus, MDCG guidance is only ever a secondary anchor, OTHER is the out-of-corpus abstention bucket.
_difficulty_cell_ceiling_doc: Hard cap on (route x primary_reg x difficulty): more than 3 identical-difficulty cases in one single-reg cell is redundancy the LLM judge pays for with no new signal.
_aggregate_soft_doc: Soft REVIEW (not a failure) when a single-reg (route x primary_reg) cell reaches this many cases across all difficulties, e.g. AI Act role obligations at 6 distinct-but-heavy cases. CROSS/CIR/MDCG/OTHER buckets are exempt (cross-regulation is a valued category, the others are single by nature).
